identification.reported_issue: fetch_preview fetches any user supplied URL, so a user could make the service request internal addresses such as http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/. Analyze this component only.

from pathlib import Path import previews def test_preview_reads_file_url(tmp_path: Path): page = tmp_path / "page.html" page.write_text("

preview

") assert previews.fetch_preview(page.as_uri()) == b"

preview

"
